issue.title: read_file at REFLEX depth returns a canned 'Read: … Preview:' instead of answering
issue.symptom: Live 2026-10-30: 'Read the file /knowledge/blueprints/COGNITIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md and tell me its first heading' went to the nano REFLEX path in ~2 of 5 fresh sessions (NeuralRouter intent=read_file target=nano source=reflex; EmbedIntentClassifier best=read_file score 0.445 < 0.45 threshold on one). Reply is '[nano] Read: <path> Preview: <first lines>' — the heading is visible but the question ('tell me its first heading') is never answered. The deliberation path answers 3/3 since gjuh.8. Same turn also runs a nano planning call whose model config has max_model_len 2048, so its system prompt is cut to 200 chars ('Truncated system message from 486 to 200 chars'); nano proxies to Core's engine, which has a larger context. Look at: when a read_file request carries a question beyond 'read X', route it through the answering path; and nano's max_model_len.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_file_read_routing_kixf.py
"""kixf: a request naming a file to read is routed deterministically. Only
"read /path" matched; "Read the file /path and tell me …" went to the LLM
selector and review, which declined it twice, and the turn fell back to a raw
preview that never answered the question."""

import pytest

from gaia_core.cognition.tool_selector import _deterministic_tool_match

P = "/knowledge/blueprints/COGNITIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", [
    f"Read the file {P} and tell me its first heading",
    f"Can you read {P} and tell me how many regions it lists?",
    f"Please open {P}.",
    f"Look at the contents of {P} — what's it about?",
    f"read {P}",
])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", [
    f"Read the file {P} and tell me its first heading",
    f"Can you read {P} and tell me how many regions it lists?",
    f"Please open {P}.",
    f"Look at the contents of {P} — what's it about?",
    f"read {P}",
])
def test_file_read_requests_match_deterministically(text):
    m = _deterministic_tool_match(text.lower(), text)
    assert m is not None and m.tool_name == "file"
    assert m.params == {"action": "read", "path": P}  # case kept, no trailing period
    assert m.selection_confidence >= 0.9  # skips the LLM review


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", [
    "I read about /r/python on reddit and liked it",
    "What do you think about reading?",
    "Tell me about /knowledge in general",
])
def test_non_requests_do_not_read(text):
    m = _deterministic_tool_match(text.lower(), text)
    assert m is None or m.tool_name != "file"

patch.format: unified diff of the candidate source files
patch.gold_diff:
diff --git a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tool_selector.py b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tool_selector.py
index 8a00402..3091ad9 100644
--- a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tool_selector.py
+++ b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tool_selector.py
@@ -346,12 +346,21 @@ def _deterministic_tool_match(lowered: str, user_input: str = "") -> Optional[Se
             selection_confidence=0.95,
         )
 
-    # File read — "read /path/to/file"
-    path_match = re.search(r'\bread\s+(/[\w/._-]+)', lowered)
+    # File read — "read /path/to/file", "read the file /path …", "open /path".
+    # kixf: only a path right after "read" matched; "Read the file /path and
+    # tell me …" went to the LLM selector, which twice declined it (a made-up
+    # knowledge(review); Prime's review at 0.42), and the turn fell back to a
+    # raw preview that never answered. Filler words between verb and path are
+    # allowed; a sentence's closing period is not part of the path. Matched on
+    # the original text: paths are case-sensitive (COGNITIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md).
+    path_match = re.search(
+        r'\b(?:read|open|summari[sz]e|look\s+(?:at|over|through))\s+'
+        r'(?:(?:the|this|that|my|me|file|doc|document|contents\s+of)\s+){0,3}(/[\w/._-]+)',
+        user_input or lowered, re.IGNORECASE)
     if path_match:
         return SelectedTool(
             tool_name="file",
-            params={"action": "read", "path": path_match.group(1)},
+            params={"action": "read", "path": path_match.group(1).rstrip(".")},
             selection_reasoning="Deterministic match: explicit file read request",
             selection_confidence=0.95,
         )
